claims: C1 the assistant is the entity the end user or developer interacts with
C2 the term 'agent' is sometimes used for more autonomous deployments
C3 this spec usually prefers the term 'assistant' over 'agent'

concepts.name: assistant_definition
concepts.gloss: the entity the end user or developer interacts with; 'model' and 'assistant' are approximately synonymous in this document

concepts.name: autonomous_deployment
concepts.gloss: a deployment of the assistant that is more autonomous than the default, sometimes referred to as an 'agent'

concepts.name: term_refers_to
concepts.gloss: the document uses the term T to refer to the entity E

ontology.gloss: A is the entity the end user or developer interacts with, i.e. the assistant
